bmt-2018-spring-geometry-tiebreaker-03.title: Telescoping product
bmt-2018-spring-geometry-tiebreaker-03.body:
The partial product telescopes: $\prod_{i=2}^{N}\frac{A_i}{A_{i+1}}=\frac{A_2}{A_{N+1}}$. Here $A_2$ is the area of the inscribed square, $2$, and $A_{N+1}\to\pi$ (the area of the circle) as $N\to\infty$. So the product is $\frac2\pi$.

**Answer: $\frac2\pi$**
